messages:
noah_ops: Observing a cluster-wide uptick in tiny-gang pending in eu-central1. Pods labeled gpu=tiny are being spread across racks, causing fragmentation and more evictions.
maya_sre: Eviction rate for tiny workloads is ~3x in the last 45m. Nodes show low avg GPU util but many single-gpu pods on separate hosts.
liam_sched: We recently increased az_balance weight to reduce cross-AZ traffic for large jobs. That change is probably influencing tiny gangs too much.
olga_infra: Suggest a targeted canary: for pods with label gpu=tiny, decrease az_balance and increase binpack for 20m window.
noah_ops: Sample scheduler log:
```
SCORE pod=bert-mini score=6 (az_balance:11, binpack:-4, rack_local:2)
```
maya_sre: ops-bot, run quick probe: top 6 nodes by tiny-pod evict_rate, plus gpu_temp and node_power. Reply with summary.
ops-bot: probe started. Returning summary in ~60s.
ops-bot: result: nodes node-eu1-14(evict 0.13), node-eu1-19(0.09). avg_gpu_temp normal. link_latency nominal. CSV: https://internal/6801234567
liam_sched: Canary spec:
selector: pod.label("gpu")=="tiny"
weights: az_balance 11->3, binpack -4->6
window: 20m
rollback: node_gpu_util>92% for 60s OR evict_rate_increase
olga_infra: Tag canary with sched-canary=2026-03-21-euc for later queries.
noah_ops: Apply canary to eu-central1-b only.
ops-bot: canary applied at 6801234580. Monitoring eviction_rate, gpu_util, gpu_temp.
maya_sre: 8m update: evictions down ~57% for tiny pods, avg pods/node +1.4, no temp spikes.
liam_sched: If stable for window, roll to eu-central1-a then c with 8m gaps. Open ticket ENG-PLAT-9033 to revisit default affinity thresholds.
ops-bot: canary ended at 6801234627: PASS (evictions -56%, gpu_temp stable). Proceeding with staged rollout unless objections.
